filters.title: Saved filters ({{count}}/20)
filters.deleteText: Remove the saved filter {{name}}? Journal records are kept.
filters.empty: Save a filter to use it again later.

logs.unitHint: Exact name, such as ssh.service; empty for all units.
logs.filterHint: Apply changes to search. Severity includes the selected level and more severe entries. Browsing pages pauses live updates.
logs.timezone: Custom times use the browser’s time zone: {{zone}}.
logs.pollHint: Live updates check every 3 seconds while the window is active.
logs.liveUntilHint: Live updates need a time range without an end time.
logs.permission: This app needs logs:read and a role authorized to read logs. An administrator can grant app permissions in the App Store.
logs.unsupported: The host cannot provide journal records. Check journald availability and agent permissions.
logs.loadFailed: Could not read logs. Check the agent connection and retry.
logs.bounds: Loaded: {{count}} · {{bytes}}. Buffer limits: {{max}} entries / {{maxBytes}}. Messages are bounded to 16,384 characters.
logs.stale: The last successful result remains visible with its retrieval time.
logs.gap: More new records arrived than one live page can return. Narrow the filter or refresh to inspect that interval.
logs.limited: The buffer limit was reached. Narrow the filter or time range to inspect more history.
logs.emptyHint: Change the filters or time range to query other records.
logs.detailHint: Select a record to read its complete collected message and metadata.

validation.unit: Enter an exact systemd unit name without paths, wildcards or '..'.
validation.search: Use at most 200 characters without NUL characters.
validation.time: Enter valid local times from 1970 onward, with the start no later than the end. Set at least one bound.
validation.name: Use a filter name of 1–80 characters.
validation.presetLimit: At most 20 filters can be saved. Remove one before saving another.

source.simulatedHint: These values are simulated by the development host and do not describe the real host.
